gallery.title: File:Palacio Real de Olite, Navarra, España, 2015-01-06, DD 07-09 HDR.JPG
gallery.description: View of the narrow Rúa Villavieja with the Palace of the Kings of Navarre in the background, Olite, Navarre, Spain. Olite is a village with a population of less than 4000, whose castle, built during the 13th and 14th centuries, was one of the seats of the Court of the Kingdom of Navarre since the reign of Charles III "the Noble".
